desc:
🌟 Welcome to Word Battle

🤯 Game currently have 5 MILLION+ words! Words suggestions feature coming soon.

How to Play:
💬 Type a word that starts with the given letter.
🚫 Words cannot be repeated!
⚡ Use boosts to gain more thinking time.
⌛  Play solo when no opponent is available.
🪑 Lose and you get launched out of the chair.
🏆 Compete on the global leaderboards.

📌 Supported Languages (more coming soon):
🇺🇸 English | 🇧🇷 Portuguese | 🇪🇸 Spanish |  🇩🇪 German | 🇫🇷 French | 🇮🇹 Italian | 🇮🇩 Indonesian 

❗ The game is in beta, so expect bugs and major changes.
Please report bugs or share feedback in-game or through the group forum.

👍 Like the game and join the group for future updates!
